data.one_liner: Extracts Dart pubspec.yaml file and generates pubspec.dart at build time
data.what_it_does: Extracts metadata and dependencies from pubspec.yaml and outputs a Dart file containing a class with these values. It can be run as a standalone command-line tool or integrated using build_runner.
use_when: You need to access app version, name, or description inside your Dart code
You want to automate reading pubspec configuration during compilation
avoid_when: You need dynamic runtime reading of external YAML assets without code generation
strengths: Supports both command-line usage and build_runner integration
Highly configurable extraction of specific top-level keys
weaknesses: Requires regeneration when pubspec.yaml changes if not using build_runner
data.setup_notes: Add pubspec_extract as a dev dependency and run via dart run or build_runner.

alternatives.name: yaml
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer parsing YAML files dynamically at runtime rather than generating static Dart code.
